upcoming.title: Upcoming Events
upcoming.subtitle: See what’s happening next across DS3.

points.Quarterly Vision & Roadmap: Our once-per-quarter GBMs unveil the full slate of events, workshops, projects, and initiatives shaping the upcoming term.
points.Meet the People Behind DS3: Connect directly with our board and leadership team, learn what we’re building, and discover how you can contribute.
points.Your Entry Point Into the Community: Whether you're new or returning, GBMs provide clear pathways to get involved, join projects, and engage meaningfully from day one.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.subtitle: Technical Depth. Real Implementation. Modern Tools.
workshops.name: Workshops

points.Production-Ready Skill Building: Go beyond surface-level tutorials and develop hands-on experience with the tools and workflows used in industry.
points.Learn by Doing: Each session centers around real implementation — writing code, debugging systems, and building projects you can actually showcase.
points.Aligned with Industry Evolution: From data pipelines and model deployment to generative AI and agent frameworks, our workshops reflect the technologies shaping today’s technical landscape.

points.Structured Mentorship & Big-Little: Build long-term academic and professional support through our mentorship initiatives and Big-Little program.
points.Community Beyond the Classroom: From beach bonfires to game nights, our socials foster genuine relationships that make campus feel smaller and more connected.
points.Collaboration Starts with Belonging: Strong technical communities are built on trust and connection — our socials create the foundation for that growth.

professional.title: Professional Events
professional.subtitle: Industry Access. Career Growth. Strategic Positioning.
professional.name: Professional Events

points.Direct Access to Industry Leaders: Engage with engineers, founders, recruiters, and alumni through curated panels, networking events, and career fairs.
points.Practical Career Preparation: Refine your resume, portfolio, interview skills, and professional presence through actionable workshops and expert feedback.
points.Clarity in Career Direction: Explore pathways across data science, AI, software engineering, and adjacent fields — and learn how to position yourself competitively.

points.Structured Interview Preparation: Work through core data structures and algorithm patterns modeled after real technical interviews.
points.Engineering-Level Problem Solving: Develop clean coding habits, optimization strategies, and pattern recognition essential for competitive recruiting.
points.Accountability Through Community: Prepare alongside peers in a consistent, high-discipline environment that builds long-term confidence.
